title: Audit learner BJT level detail screen

spec.problem: The active BJT level detail screen calls five Go APIs that are unregistered, so /vi/levels/J1 renders not found and vocabulary/kanji/grammar tabs cannot load; lesson completion summary still reads localStorage instead of persisted learner progress.

acceptance.text: GET /api/levels/{code} returns the established BJT metadata and canonical active content counts; unknown code is 404.

GET /api/levels/{code}/lessons returns only active/published ordered lesson summaries, accurate activity/reference counts, and optional authenticated isCompleted from PostgreSQL; no-content is an empty array.

GET vocabulary, kanji and grammar tabs return active canonical rows for the mapped BJT/JLPT level, honor parameterized search and validated pagination, preserve nested read DTO fields, and never mutate master rows.

Visible anonymous and authenticated /vi/levels/J1 flows, tab interactions and mobile 390x844 render without page errors/overflow; lesson progress from detail is reflected on this screen after navigation and refresh.
Public level lesson reads remain registered when learner sessions are unavailable.
Public level reads are bounded by an IP-based route limit and fail closed without the dedicated limiter.

spec.expected_behavior: Known BJT levels render canonical level metadata and content counts; level lesson lists show published curriculum, activity/reference counts and the current learner's saved completion; read-only reference tabs query active canonical lexeme, kanji and grammar rows with safe search/pagination.
spec.observed_behavior: Visible authenticated /vi/levels/J1 shows Không tìm thấy trình độ này; GET /api/levels/J1 and GET /api/levels/J1/lessons both return 404. Source shows all four content-tab API callers are also unregistered, and completion list reads bjt_lesson_completed localStorage.
spec.rollback_plan: Revert the screen/API commit; retain canonical content and existing progress data. The routes are read-only and require no data migration or master-content writes.
